section_summary.extract_value: The Introduction reviews rising rates of cosmetic procedures and summarizes prior research linking willingness to undergo cosmetic surgery to factors such as age, self-assessed attractiveness, media exposure, and negative body image. It states that the present study examines associations between the ACSS Consider subscale and body appreciation, media influence, BMI, and age; no study numbering or sample details are provided in this section.
section_summary.evidence_source: "In recent years, developed countries have witnessed a dramatic increase in the number of cosmetic procedures being performed annually..." and "The present study sought to extend this body of research by examining the association between the Consider subscale of the ACSS ... and body appreciation, media influence, and respondentweight status and age."
